premise: Duckling isn't sure about the pond and hides his head under his wing; Snail shows him that he hides too when things are new — and then peeks out, just a little — so Duckling peeks, dips one orange foot, then the other, and his webbed feet push like paddles: he floats!
inspiration: The Ugly Duckling (Andersen), turned: nobody is unkind, and he finds his place by trying, one foot at a time.
learning: Ducks paddle with their webbed feet.

en-US.title: Duckling Dares the Water
en-US.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.7 20s} It was a warm, sunny morning. {frog:enter} {frog:go to pond} Frog sat at the edge of the pond, {frog:live catch-fly} catching flies. Snap! Gulp! {frog:face happy} "Come on in, {duckling:enter} Duckling!" {duckling:go to pond} Duckling waddled up to the edge. {duckling:face sad} The water looked very big. And very wet. [nervously] "Maybe tomorrow," he said, and {duckling:live nap hold} tucked his head under his wing. Slowly, slowly, up crawled {snail:enter} {snail:go to duckling} Snail. [gently] "Are you hiding?" he asked. "I hide too, when something's new. Like this." {snail:live hide hold} In he went. Then… {snail:live hide resume} out he peeked, just a tiny bit. {duckling:live nap resume} So Duckling peeked out too. {duckling:live dip-foot} One orange foot went in. {sfx:splash} Plip. Then the other. Plop. And then… {duckling:go to pond another by swim} his webbed feet pushed the water like paddles, push, push, and he was floating! {duckling:face surprised} [gasps] "I'm swimming!" {duckling:face happy} {duckling:live quack} {frog:hop x2} {sfx:quack} QUACK! {snail:face happy} {snail:hearts} [happily] Snail smiled. HE wasn't going in. But he'd come and watch. Every single day.

es-ES.title: Patito se atreve con el agua
es-ES.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.7 20s} Era una mañana de sol, calentita. {frog:enter} {frog:go to pond} Rana estaba en la orilla de la charca, {frog:live catch-fly} cazando moscas. ¡Zas! ¡Glup! {frog:face happy} —¡Venga, métete, {duckling:enter} Patito! {duckling:go to pond} Patito se acercó a la orilla, bamboleándose. {duckling:face sad} El agua parecía muy grande. Y muy mojada. [nervously] —Mejor mañana —dijo, y {duckling:live nap hold} escondió la cabeza bajo el ala. Despacito, despacito, llegó {snail:enter} {snail:go to duckling} Caracol. [gently] —¿Te estás escondiendo? —le preguntó—. Yo también me escondo cuando algo es nuevo. Mira, así. {snail:live hide hold} Y se metió en su concha. Luego… {snail:live hide resume} asomó, solo un poquito. {duckling:live nap resume} Y Patito también asomó. {duckling:live dip-foot} Metió una pata naranja en el agua. {sfx:splash} Plic. Luego la otra. Ploc. Y entonces… {duckling:go to pond another by swim} sus patas palmeadas empujaron el agua como dos remos, chap, chap, y… ¡flotaba! {duckling:face surprised} [gasps] —¡Estoy nadando! {duckling:face happy} {duckling:live quack} {frog:hop x2} {sfx:quack} ¡CUA, CUA! {snail:face happy} {snail:hearts} [happily] Caracol sonrió. ÉL no pensaba meterse, eso no. Pero vendría a mirar. Todos los días.

ja-JP.title: アヒルの子、はじめての およぎ
ja-JP.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.7 20s}ぽかぽかの、はれた朝。{frog:enter}{frog:go to pond}カエルさんが池のふちで、{frog:live catch-fly}ハエをつかまえています。ぺろっ！ごくん！{frog:face happy}「おいでよ！」 と、{duckling:enter}アヒルの子をよびました。{duckling:go to pond}アヒルの子は、ふちまでよちよち。{duckling:face sad}池は、とっても大きくて、とってもぬれてそう。[nervously]「また、あしたにする…」 と、{duckling:live nap hold}つばさにあたまをかくしました。ゆっくり、ゆっくり、{snail:enter}{snail:go to duckling}カタツムリくんがやってきました。[gently]「かくれてるの？ぼくも、はじめてのことは、かくれちゃう。こんなふうに。」 {snail:live hide hold}すぽっ。それから…{snail:live hide resume}ちょっぴり、のぞきました。{duckling:live nap resume}アヒルの子も、そっとのぞきました。{duckling:live dip-foot}オレンジの足を、かたほう入れて…{sfx:splash}ちゃぷ。もうかたほう。ぽちゃ。そして…{duckling:go to pond another by swim}みずかきが、オールみたいに水をおして、すい、すい…ういてる！{duckling:face surprised}[gasps]「およいでる！」 {duckling:face happy}{duckling:live quack}{frog:hop x2}{sfx:quack}ガーッ！{snail:face happy}{snail:hearts}[happily]カタツムリくんは、にっこり。ぼくは、入らないけどね。でも、見にくるよ。まいにち、かならず。

de-DE.title: Das Entchen traut sich ins Wasser
de-DE.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.7 20s} Es war ein warmer, sonniger Morgen. {frog:enter} {frog:go to pond} Der Frosch saß am Teich und {frog:live catch-fly} fing Fliegen. Schnapp! Schluck! {frog:face happy} „Komm doch rein, {duckling:enter} Entchen!“ {duckling:go to pond} Das Entchen watschelte bis ans Ufer. {duckling:face sad} Das Wasser sah sehr groß aus. Und sehr nass. [nervously] „Vielleicht morgen“, sagte es und {duckling:live nap hold} steckte den Kopf unter den Flügel. Langsam, ganz langsam kam {snail:enter} {snail:go to duckling} die Schnecke herangekrochen. [gently] „Versteckst du dich?“, fragte sie. „Ich verstecke mich auch, wenn etwas neu ist. So.“ {snail:live hide hold} Schwupp, war sie im Haus. Dann… {snail:live hide resume} lugte sie heraus, nur ein winziges bisschen. {duckling:live nap resume} Da lugte auch das Entchen heraus. {duckling:live dip-foot} Ein orangefarbener Fuß tauchte ins Wasser. {sfx:splash} Plitsch. Dann der andere. Platsch. Und dann… {duckling:go to pond another by swim} schoben seine Schwimmfüße das Wasser weg wie Paddel, schieb, schieb, und schon trieb es auf dem Teich! {duckling:face surprised} [gasps] „Ich schwimme!“ {duckling:face happy} {duckling:live quack} {frog:hop x2} {sfx:quack} QUAK! {snail:face happy} {snail:hearts} [happily] Die Schnecke lächelte. SIE ging nicht ins Wasser. Aber zuschauen wollte sie. Jeden einzelnen Tag.

fr-FR.title: Caneton se jette à l’eau
fr-FR.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.7 20s} C’était un matin chaud et ensoleillé. {frog:enter} {frog:go to pond} Grenouille, assise au bord de la mare, {frog:live catch-fly} attrapait des mouches. Clac ! Gloup ! {frog:face happy} « Viens te baigner, {duckling:enter} Caneton ! » {duckling:go to pond} Caneton s’est dandiné jusqu’au bord. {duckling:face sad} L’eau avait l’air très grande. Et très mouillée. [nervously] « Peut-être demain », a-t-il dit, et {duckling:live nap hold} il a mis la tête sous l’aile. Tout doucement, tout doucement, est arrivé {snail:enter} {snail:go to duckling} Escargot. [gently] « Tu te caches ? a-t-il demandé. Moi aussi, je me cache quand quelque chose est nouveau. Comme ça. » {snail:live hide hold} Et hop, dans sa coquille. Puis… {snail:live hide resume} il a ressorti ses cornes, juste un tout petit peu. {duckling:live nap resume} Alors Caneton aussi a pointé le bout du bec. {duckling:live dip-foot} Une patte orange est entrée dans l’eau. {sfx:splash} Plic. Puis l’autre. Ploc. Et alors… {duckling:go to pond another by swim} ses pattes palmées ont poussé l’eau comme des pagaies, pousse, pousse, et il flottait ! {duckling:face surprised} [gasps] « Je nage ! » {duckling:face happy} {duckling:live quack} {frog:hop x2} {sfx:quack} COIN-COIN ! {snail:face happy} {snail:hearts} [happily] Escargot a souri. LUI, il n’irait pas dans l’eau. Mais il viendrait regarder. Tous les jours.

it-IT.title: Anatroccolo si fa coraggio
it-IT.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.7 20s} Era una mattina calda e piena di sole. {frog:enter} {frog:go to pond} Rana se ne stava sul bordo dello stagno, {frog:live catch-fly} ad acchiappare mosche. Zac! Gnam! {frog:face happy} «Vieni a fare il bagno, {duckling:enter} Anatroccolo!» {duckling:go to pond} Anatroccolo si è avvicinato al bordo, dondolando. {duckling:face sad} L'acqua sembrava tanto grande. E tanto bagnata. [nervously] «Magari domani», ha detto, e {duckling:live nap hold} ha nascosto la testa sotto l'ala. Piano piano, è arrivata strisciando {snail:enter} {snail:go to duckling} Chiocciola. [gently] «Ti stai nascondendo?» ha chiesto. «Anch'io mi nascondo, quando c'è qualcosa di nuovo. Così.» {snail:live hide hold} Ed è sparita nel guscio. Poi… {snail:live hide resume} ha sbirciato fuori, solo un pochino. {duckling:live nap resume} Allora anche Anatroccolo ha sbirciato fuori. {duckling:live dip-foot} Ha messo dentro una zampa arancione. {sfx:splash} Plic. Poi l'altra. Ploc. E poi… {duckling:go to pond another by swim} le sue zampe palmate hanno spinto l'acqua come due remi, spingi e spingi, e lui galleggiava! {duckling:face surprised} [gasps] «Sto nuotando!» {duckling:face happy} {duckling:live quack} {frog:hop x2} {sfx:quack} QUA QUA! {snail:face happy} {snail:hearts} [happily] Chiocciola ha sorriso. LEI non ci pensava proprio, a tuffarsi. Però sarebbe venuta a guardare. Tutti, tutti i giorni.

zh-TW.title: 小鴨敢下水了
zh-TW.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.7 20s}這是一個暖洋洋的早晨。{frog:enter}{frog:go to pond}青蛙坐在池塘邊，{frog:live catch-fly}抓蒼蠅吃。啪！咕嚕！{frog:face happy}「快下來玩嘛，{duckling:enter}小鴨！」 {duckling:go to pond}小鴨搖搖擺擺地走到池塘邊。{duckling:face sad}水看起來好大好大，而且濕答答的。[nervously]「明天再說好了。」 牠說完，{duckling:live nap hold}把頭埋進翅膀底下。慢慢的，慢慢的，{snail:enter}{snail:go to duckling}蝸牛爬了過來。[gently]「你在躲起來嗎？」 牠問，「遇到新的事，我也會躲喔。像這樣。」 {snail:live hide hold}牠縮進殼裡。然後……{snail:live hide resume}偷偷探出一點點頭。{duckling:live nap resume}小鴨也探出頭來。{duckling:live dip-foot}一隻橘色的腳伸進水裡。{sfx:splash}撲。再伸進另一隻。通。接著……{duckling:go to pond another by swim}牠有蹼的腳掌像兩支小槳，划、划，往後推水，牠浮起來了！{duckling:face surprised}[gasps]「我在游泳！」 {duckling:face happy}{duckling:live quack}{frog:hop x2}{sfx:quack}嘎嘎！{snail:face happy}{snail:hearts}[happily]蝸牛笑了。牠自己才不下去呢。不過，牠會來看小鴨游泳。每一天都來。

zh-HK.title: 小鴨學游水
zh-HK.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.7 20s}這是一個暖洋洋、陽光普照的早上。{frog:enter}{frog:go to pond}青蛙坐在池塘邊，{frog:live catch-fly}捉蒼蠅吃。啪！咕嘟！{frog:face happy}「快啲落嚟玩啦，{duckling:enter}小鴨！」 {duckling:go to pond}小鴨一搖一擺地走到池塘邊。{duckling:face sad}池水看起來很大很大，還很濕很濕。[nervously]「不如……聽日先啦。」 牠說完，{duckling:live nap hold}就把頭藏進翅膀底下。慢慢地，慢慢地，{snail:enter}{snail:go to duckling}蝸牛爬了過來。[gently]「你係咪匿埋呀？」 牠問，「遇到新嘢，我都會匿埋㗎。好似咁。」 {snail:live hide hold}牠縮進殼裏。然後……{snail:live hide resume}偷偷探出一點點頭來。{duckling:live nap resume}小鴨也探出頭來。{duckling:live dip-foot}一隻橙色的腳伸進水裏。{sfx:splash}滴。再伸進另一隻。嗒。接着……{duckling:go to pond another by swim}牠有蹼的腳掌好像兩支小槳，划、划，把水向後推，牠浮起來了！{duckling:face surprised}[gasps]「我識游水喇！」 {duckling:face happy}{duckling:live quack}{frog:hop x2}{sfx:quack}嘎嘎！{snail:face happy}{snail:hearts}[happily]蝸牛笑了。牠自己才不下水呢。不過，牠會來看小鴨游水。每一天都來。
